title: MacDeviceApprovalPipe
responsibility: Exchanges one JSON request and response at a time with the signed macOS helper over private process streams.

inputs.name: MacDeviceApprovalPipe.constructor.binary
inputs.description: Absolute path to the bundled native helper.

inputs.name: MacDeviceApprovalPipe.request.input
inputs.description: A main-process command for the helper. The start command may hold an OAuth session that travels only through the pipe.

outputs.name: MacDeviceApprovalPipe.request
outputs.description: One decoded newline-delimited JSON reply. Connection, timeout and malformed response failures close the pipe.

outputs.name: MacDeviceApprovalPipe.close
outputs.description: Ends the helper process and closes the private input stream.

errors.name: MacDeviceApprovalError
errors.description: A public, bounded failure code reports a refusal or an unavailable helper without including request contents.
